description: This file implements a VirtualInput class for handling various input events such as keyboard, mouse, and touch inputs, including platform-specific implementations for Linux. It manages input mappings, dispatches input events, and communicates with other components via IPC. The code includes classes, methods, and logic for input event processing, modifiers, and device management.

classes.name: InputEvent
classes.description: A helper class to encapsulate different input event data (keyboard, mouse, touch) and provide string representations for debugging.

methods.name: VirtualInput::KeyMap::Import
methods.description: Imports key mapping entries from a JSON array into the internal key map, updating modifiers and change tracking.

methods.name: VirtualInput::KeyMap::Export
methods.description: Exports the current key map into a JSON array for external use or serialization.

methods.name: VirtualInput::Register
methods.description: Registers a callback notifier for a specific key code, or for all keys if keyCode is ~0.

methods.name: VirtualInput::Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback notifier for a specific key code, or for all keys if keyCode is ~0.

methods.name: VirtualInput::AxisEvent
methods.description: Generates a scroll (axis) input event with specified x and y offsets.

methods.name: VirtualInput::PointerMotionEvent
methods.description: Generates a mouse motion event with specified x and y movement.

methods.name: VirtualInput::PointerButtonEvent
methods.description: Generates a mouse button press or release event.

methods.name: VirtualInput::TouchEvent
methods.description: Generates a touch event with specified index, state, and position.

methods.name: VirtualInput::KeyEvent
methods.description: Processes a key press or release event, mapping it through the current key map and dispatching it.

methods.name: VirtualInput::RepeatKey
methods.description: Handles key repeat events, dispatching repeat and release events as needed.

methods.name: VirtualInput::SendModifier
methods.description: Manages reference counting for modifier keys and determines if a modifier key event should be triggered.

methods.name: VirtualInput::ModifierKey
methods.description: Generates modifier key press/release events based on the current modifiers bitmask.

methods.name: VirtualInput::DispatchRegisteredKey
methods.description: Dispatches a key event, considering parent lookup mappings, and notifies registered notifiers.

methods.name: VirtualInput::MapChanges
methods.description: Applies key mapping changes, updating device keys and recreating virtual devices on Linux.

methods.name: VirtualInput::LookupChanges
methods.description: Triggers reload of input mappings for a specific link name.
